name: nova-saas-universal-engagement
description: Nova v59.0 (Sprint 14 Knowledge Engine v2 — all 6 phases complete). Phase 1: deleted duplicate knowledge-engine, unified retrieval path (16 tests). Phase 2: structure-aware chunker (heading+body, lists, tables stay together), ingestion validation reports, source versioning with draft/published/archived states + supersedes + effectiveFrom/Until (23 tests). Phase 3: IntentRouter (routes pricing/availability/booking/order to structured systems, RAG for faq/policy/service), QueryRewriter (13 expansion patterns behind dedicated interface), EvidenceValidator (verified/incomplete/conflicting/stale/unauthorized/none), TrainedEmbeddingProvider (all-MiniLM-L6-v2 + multilingual, graceful fallback) (35 tests). Phase 4: AnswerComposer (LLM + extractive fallback, structured-fact injection), ResponseValidator (rejects uncited claims + unsupported money/duration/count/date values + internal-evidence leaks), DecisionEngine (answer/clarify/escalate/refuse), CitationBuilder, AbstentionHandler (multilingual en/ur/roman-urdu) (29 tests). Phase 5: PostgresRepository + pgvector VectorRepository + RedisCache (pub/sub cross-instance invalidation) + TenantIsolation, all with graceful fallback to single-node file mode, migrations/001_knowledge_schema.sql, ROLLBACK.md (20 tests). Phase 6: 6 new admin endpoints (/chunks, /playground, /test, /analytics, /evaluate, /publish), AnalyticsEngine.getKnowledgeDashboard (retrieval volume, answerable/abstain/clarify/escalate/conflict rates, p95 latency, top sources, failed ingestion jobs), 23-case knowledge evaluation corpus (en + roman-urdu + ur, all 4 outcomes + security + conflict) (23 tests). Total: 146 new tests, 0 regressions in 580+ existing tests.
